def _verse(verse):
    index = verse - 1
    animal = _ANIMALS[index]
    lines = [
        f"I know an old lady who swallowed a {animal}.",
        _COMMENTS[animal],
    ]
    while index > 0 and index != len(_ANIMALS) - 1:
        index -= 1
        caught = _ANIMALS[index]
        lines.append(
            f"She swallowed the {animal} to catch the {_swallowed_line(caught)}."
        )
        animal = caught
    return lines
